logp.method_description: The log P of the compounds were determined via shake flask using the previously published procedure [10]. A known amount of each complex (3a-3u) was suspended in water (pre-saturated with n-octanol) and shaken for four days on an orbital shaker. To allow the phase separation, the solution was centrifuged for 10 min at 3000 rpm. Then the amount ruthenium present in saturated aqueous solution was measured by ICP-MS. To obtain the partition coefficient, different ratios (0.5 : 1, 1 : 1, and 2 : 1) of the saturated solutions were shaken with pre-saturated n-octanol for 20 min on an orbital shaker and followed the same procedure.
